public_rationale: Marcus said the ants in a Sora video lacked their six legs. An HTC VIVE blog post from March 2024, written independently of Marcus, says that in the Sora ant-tunnel video "the ants have only four legs instead of the correct six." Wikimedia Commons dates that OpenAI Sora ant-nest clip to 18 February 2024, the day of the post, and files it under misgenerated legs. No source says the ants have six legs.
limitations: The leg count comes from a secondary blog. I did not count the legs myself.
I assume the clip in the post is the ant-nest tunnel video.
